name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: Either Greta goes with Slate or Almond goes with Edith.
Pumpkin goes with at least one of Cara or Jade.
Almond, Maple, and Pumpkin go with Cobalt, Jade, and Slate, in some order.
Edith, Maple, and Pumpkin go with Jade, Onyx, and Slate, in some order.
Pumpkin goes with exactly one of Dane, Edith, or Slate.

hints.text: Suppose Edith went with Cobalt — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Edith goes with Cobalt.
Edith goes with Cobalt, so it can't also go with Jade.
Edith goes with Cobalt, so it can't also go with Onyx.
Edith goes with Cobalt, so it can't also go with Slate.
…but now the clue “Edith, Maple, and Pumpkin go with Jade, Onyx, and Slate, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Edith does not go with Cobalt.
